column1: # The routes and what must hold on each replay: tools/check_routes.py (ctest oracles-routes, with ORACLES_ROM_DIR set).

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the objects' animation stepped from the fan game's tables against the live game (--object-animation-check): every pose change of the Subrosians and the dungeon's objects at their place that a neighbour animates by the rule is the game's, both ways; the probe's verdict is the game's on its first updates after each scroll (eight objects); every pose shown live has its tiles in the capture; four objects of the captures are an entry ahead after the scroll, which the game updates during it.

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the sub-pixel camera (--enhanced-subpixel): a fan game, Subrosia and a dungeon. Link's step changes by 14 px at the start and the end of the dungeon's vertical scrolls between large rooms (5670, 5702, 7111, 7143), the game carrying him at the scroll's speed: drawn at his fraction of a pixel in the large rooms, his half pixels come and go and those frames count as a switch, where before they counted elsewhere.

# Enhanced on mGBA, subrosia-and-dungeon.route: on mGBA the route goes through the same rooms, but Link's position first differs at frame 3613, the frames the game's logic does not finish in falling elsewhere (a turnaround more, other walking and text frames after). Replayed to frame 3600, it shows on mGBA SameBoy's black (140 a frame on average, 5334 at most): the black above the ceiling of SameBoy's row (mean 100 against 97 over the route) is mGBA's game's, after it differs.

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the rooms never visited kept dark (--unvisited-rooms hidden): the game's record of the rooms entered on Temple of Seasons' profile, each room fading in at its first entry.
# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the status bar drawn full width (--hud full): Subrosia's colours and a dungeon's, far and far 4:3.

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the transitions' diagonal (--continuous-diagonal): Link carried left and up into 1:58 and left and down into 1:57 in Subrosia, walls across holding him there (transitions.carried_frames, carry_withheld_frames), the game going elsewhere from 2719 on; his sprite steps back once (enhanced.link_backsteps_y), a pose of normal play at 8066, and his place jumps once more, a teleport inside 1:48 at 2998.

# The compact text (--text compact, Enhanced alone), Temple's English laid out again in the banks its profile leaves to a language and drawn by the transaction at the profile's routines: compact-subrosia-and-dungeon.route, subrosia-and-dungeon.route's keys moved for the dialogues the compact text closes sooner (its comment), the same rooms; its dialogues' lines in the font's own widths, none past 128 pixels, the reveal to the pixel (none cut or early; one vblank of a line revealed more on SameBoy than on mGBA), the box where the game drew it.
# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the status bar laid out (--hud wide): Temple of Seasons' bar is the base game's, laid out in every world frame, Subrosia's and a dungeon's included.

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with Text size Large and Very large (--text-size, the counters of ages/checks.tsv): the game's box enlarged from the core's image, as in Ages and Seasons, on the 1608 frames of a text, 63 of them over the framed core (on mGBA, whose dialogues close on other frames, 1590 and 64); the box the host draws compared with the core's on each of them (--text-box-check); the live state that of its row without them.

# The wide text box (--text-box wide, the counters of ages/checks.tsv), Temple's English laid out again at 192 pixels, classic at the game's fixed advance and compact (text.boxes as the game lays them out, text.boxes_laid_out as served): each frame the box shows, its text against its layout's glyphs, none wrong, none uncovered, cut or early, none past 192 pixels; the pages the game keeps laid out for its 128 pixels centred. The route's keys depend on the pages: past its first dialogue, closed in fewer boxes, the replay goes its own way, the same on each, through fewer rooms (transitions.taken), its dialogues there judged as well.

# ammo.route: subrosia-and-dungeon.route's keys, then by hand at its end a seed from the satchel on B (10440) and a bomb dropped (10620), its blast taken; --poke-at gives Link, whose save has none, five seeds (Temple's seeds share one count, $c6ad, Seasons' wNumBombchus) at 10435, then five bombs on B at 10610 (wInventoryB, wNumBombs, the bombs' obtained flag). With --cheats ammo both are kept; with every cheat the hits of the route and the blast cost no heart, every point armed (four hits on SameBoy, six on mGBA, whose game parts from SameBoy's at 3613, as subrosia-and-dungeon.route's rows say). No route of Temple has a purchase: its prices, taken from $c6a7 (Seasons' wNumOreChunks), are held by oracles-cheats-roms, which calls its removeRupeeValue in the core.
